sentence: I read your sketch as: a sign-in form card: heading, subheading, labeled email and password inputs, a blue 'Sign in' button, and a blue 'Forgot your password?' link, all inside a bordered card on a light gray page background. But I couldn't add what you drew. Also, one of your marks didn't match anything on the page, so I skipped it. Undo puts your files back the way they were.
